title: Chemtrails Versus Contrails
snippet: Do you know the difference between a chemtrail and a contrail? A contrail is an abbreviation for "condensation trail," which is a visible white vapor trail produced as water vapor condenses from aircraft engine exhaust. Chemtrails, on the other hand, are "chemical trails" purportedly resulting from an intentional high-altitude release of chemical or biological agents. Atmospheric experts and government agencies say there is no basis for the chemtrail conspiracy theory.
quote: Atmospheric experts and government agencies say there is no basis for the chemtrail conspiracy theory.
stance_why: Frames the spraying program as a conspiracy theory and cites experts/agencies saying it has no basis.

title: Chemtrails Conspiracy Theory

title: Are Chemicals Being Secretly Sprayed in Our Skies?
snippet: The white streaks many people point to as "chemtrails" are in most cases condensation trails — contrails — formed when aircraft exhaust condenses in cold, humid upper-atmosphere air, and scientists and agencies have explained this repeatedly. The EPA and other agencies explicitly acknowledge that aircraft sometimes intentionally release chemicals for firefighting, agricultural spraying, and controlled experiments, but these operations are low-altitude, visible, documented and regulated — not covert high-altitude dispersals over entire populations.
quote: The white streaks many people point to as "chemtrails" are in most cases condensation trails — contrails — formed when aircraft exhaust condenses in cold, humid upper-atmosphere air
stance_why: Observed streaks are ordinary contrails; legitimate aerial sprays are low-altitude, documented and regulated, not covert.
